# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [Pando changes Git's server side for parallel development](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-03/01-pando-git-service.html) — OpenAI described its operational backend, highlighting why write speed and commit availability need separate checks.
- [Grid Protectors proposes flexible demand from future compute campuses](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-03/02-grid-protectors-demand.html) — OpenAI's program concerns negotiated electricity-demand flexibility, with household-bill outcomes still requiring evidence.
- [OpenAI raises bug bounties and prepares another defensive sprint](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-03/03-security-incentives-sprint.html) — New incentives for external researchers accompany a planned collaboration with Cathedral, rather than reporting a newly discovered attack.
- [Transformers proposes small contracts for model integration tests](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-03/04-transformers-contracts.html) — Model Integration Contracts connect a fixture, runnable example and expected result, while full-model tests remain necessary.
- [IBM compares three agent harnesses using the same model](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-03/05-cuga-harness-comparison.html) — A new CUGA, Hermes and Deep Agents comparison examines the surrounding system, without measuring business-policy enforcement.
- [NASA shows two different paths for Pacific typhoons](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-03/06-pacific-storm-transition.html) — In-fa retained an annular form while Champi's remnants joined an extratropical system, in imagery acquired in late October.
- [Twin ESCAPADE spacecraft prepare for powered Earth flybys toward Mars](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-03/07-escapade-earth-flybys.html) — Engine-assisted flybys are scheduled for November 7 and 9, with Mars arrival planned for September 2027.
- [A study of 37 dwarf galaxies finds an oxygen shortfall](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-03/08-dwarf-galaxies-oxygen.html) — Archival Hubble observations help reconstruct chemical histories, while the location of all missing material remains unresolved.
- [ProtoStar starts a climate challenge tested against observed years](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-02/01-protostar-climate-challenge.html) — The challenge is scheduled to start November 2, with current rules specifying 2019–2025 rather than the initial announcement's horizon.
- [Who accepts AI-written code when the same system wrote the tests?](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-02/02-ai-code-acceptance-evidence.html) — A new opinion essay separates implementation generation from engineering acceptance; a worked example illustrates the boundary.
- [Short answers do not establish how a model remembers during long reasoning](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-02/03-memory-long-generations.html) — A new author-reported comparison of sliding windows and hybrid memory highlights generation length as a separate evaluation dimension.
- [Landsat shows Pennsylvania's autumn canyon and a river's reversed course](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-02/04-pine-creek-gorge-landsat.html) — A new NASA feature connects October views of Pine Creek Gorge with glacial history and forest recovery.
- [NASA seeks industry options for servicing Hubble and raising its orbit](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-01/01-hubble-servicing-options.html) — An information request remains open until November 30, exploring capabilities rather than approving a rescue mission.
- [NASA schedules a Moon Base update and X-59 display at MAX POWER](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-01/02-max-power-november-program.html) — The November 6–8 program combines aviation, space hardware and crew appearances, with the events still ahead.
- [NESformer puts an NES CPU in model weights while keeping graphics outside](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-01/03-nesformer-compiled-cpu.html) — The experiment compiles computation instead of learning games, with substantial speed and cartridge limitations.
- [Vega Island imagery shows why dark ice matters more than a skull-like shape](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-01/04-vega-island-exposed-ice.html) — NASA compared Landsat scenes from different seasons and years, explaining snow cover without treating two pictures as a mass-loss measurement.
- [Ai2 tests why AI changes its verdict on a research idea's novelty](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/01-ai2-novelty-judges.html) — A new benchmark reveals sensitivity to question wording, especially when evaluating generated ideas.
- [LFM3 puts text, vision and audio models on a shared compact backbone](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/02-lfm3-specialized-models.html) — Liquid AI introduced six variants intended for specialization and deployment close to the application.
- [Oracle is developing access to business applications through ChatGPT](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/03-oracle-chatgpt-workspace.html) — The partners described an AI Workspace governed by company permissions and a U.S. Marketplace purchasing route.
- [NEO Surveyor's sunshade will block sunlight and supply spacecraft power](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/04-neo-surveyor-sunshade.html) — NASA detailed solar-cell integration and testing of a major component of the future infrared telescope.
